summary: Iteration 8 testing: global country filter, Q-o-Q trend indicators on KPI cards, Scenario Simulator Turkey/Italy location_impact cards. Backend pytest 20/21 passed (1 real bug: /api/dashboard/org-health ignores country query param). Frontend verified: country selector toggles HC correctly (All=402, Italy=115, Turkey=287), Scenario Sim renders both Turkey (287→315, +28) and Italy (115→126, +11) cards via data-testids.

critical.issue: country query param is NOT respected. Endpoint signature at server.py:1459 is `get_org_health(year: int = 2025)` — missing `country: str = None` param and pass-through to get_filtered(). Response for ?country=Italy is byte-identical to no filter (band_pyramid totals 402, all 10 depts including Turkey-only ones like Supply Chain returned). Spec explicitly requires: 'Org Health page respects country filter'.

passed_tests: GET /api/dashboard/overview returns trends={headcount,hires,leaves,turnover} each with prev/delta/pct keys
Italy HC + Turkey HC == All HC (115+287=402) — partition correct
GET /api/dashboard/headcount?country=Italy returns only Italian cities (Genova, Villanova d'Asti)
GET /api/dashboard/headcount?country=Turkey returns only Turkish cities (Istanbul, Ankara, Izmir, Bursa, Antalya)
GET /api/dashboard/turnover?country=Italy returns different KPIs than unfiltered
POST /api/simulator/scenario returns location_impact array with Turkey + Italy entries, each having current/projected/delta
Frontend: country selector switching updates Overview HC live (115 ↔ 287 ↔ 402)
Frontend: Scenario Simulator renders [data-testid='location-turkey'] and [data-testid='location-italy'] cards showing Current → Projected with delta tag
Trend indicator(s) rendered on Overview (at least 1 element matched, KPICard component has trend prop)
Regression: 9 existing endpoints (overview, headcount, turnover, org-health, hires, leaves, recruitment, performance, years) all return 200
No DOM error markers / no console errors during navigation
action_items: Fix /api/dashboard/org-health to accept optional `country: str = None` query param and call `await get_filtered(year, country)` (currently signature has only year). The function uses active list for all aggregations, so adding the country filter is a 2-line change.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1883 lines — earlier recommendation to split into routers still pending; planning/insights/people modules would help maintainability.

Trend pct calculations in overview use `max(1, len(prev_left))` for leaves but bare `prev_hired` / `prev_hc` divisors for hires/headcount — inconsistent guard. If prev_hired==0 then guard returns 0 (OK), but ZeroDivisionError protection style is inconsistent. Consider helper `pct_delta(cur, prev)`.

Trends 'turnover' object sets pct=0 hardcoded (line 414) while delta is computed — UI cannot show % change for turnover. Either compute (cur-prev)/prev*100 or document why it's intentionally absolute delta only.
country_distribution returns [] when country filter is applied (line 417). UI may show empty chart instead of hiding it — verify hidden state.

Org Health endpoint signature missing country param is a regression caught by the listed spec — likely an oversight when adding country filter across endpoints. /api/dashboard/headcount, /turnover, /headcount-plan, /overview all received the update; org-health was missed.

Scenario Simulator endpoint is POST /api/simulator/scenario (not /dashboard/scenario-simulate as initially guessed); naming inconsistency vs. other dashboard endpoints — consider standardising under /dashboard/* or moving all simulators under /simulator/*.

success_rate.backend: 95.2% (20/21 pytest — only org-health country filter failed)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (country selector, KPI updates, scenario location cards all verified)

seed_data_creation: Used existing seed. Verified HC=402 total (Turkey=287, Italy=115).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Country filter wiring complete on 4/5 endpoints (overview, headcount, turnover, headcount-plan). Org Health is the only miss. Scenario endpoint is at POST /api/simulator/scenario (not /dashboard/...). location_impact returns hardcoded Turkey+Italy list. Frontend KPICard accepts trend prop {delta, pct, inverse}; visual TrendUp/TrendDown arrows rendered. After org-health fix, re-run test_country_trends.py::TestOrgHealthCountry. All testids are stable: country-selector, year-selector, location-turkey, location-italy, top-bar, page-title, pdf-export-btn.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause for org-health filter failure: server.py line 1459 defines `async def get_org_health(year: int = 2025)` without a `country` parameter. Inside, it calls `await get_filtered(year)` (no country arg). Two-line fix: (1) add `country: str = None` to signature, (2) pass `country` to get_filtered. No other code changes needed — all downstream aggregations operate on the returned `active` list.
